sentences.text: This marine reptile's scientific name means 'blood-biting tyrant swimmer'.
The original specimen featured a jaw measuring exactly 67 centimeters long.
Other individuals possessed skulls and jaws reaching roughly one meter in length.
Its lower jaw measured about 66 centimeters and held sharp, blade-like teeth.
Taxonomically, it belongs to the metriorhynchid subfamily Geosaurinae and the tribe Geosaurini.
Fossils were found in the Oxford Clay Formation of England and the Marnes de Dives of France.
It lived from the Callovian to the Oxfordian stages, between 165.3 and 159 million years ago.
